rule: A family is a shared root with 1-3 visible stages; each stage is one class with a stars value and a stat row. Stage 1 to 2 roughly doubles hp and atk (mean hp x2.12, atk x2.28 in my tally over 397 pairs); stage 2 to 3 is smaller (x1.65, x1.85). Variety comes from a packed variant byte (shiny bit plus 7-bit emotion index, 20 emotion slots), per-species attack motion and element-keyed attack and hit sprites (39 and 18 keys), and one skill per species that the top stage may drop. Bosses are existing species on PvE boards with an emotion tint, a statBoosts block and held items. Synergy tiers are count thresholds (for example 2,4,6,8 or 3,5,7,9).
keep: 3-stage merge ladder with a visible step up at each stage
element-keyed hit look (one key per element), not one per creature
packed variant byte: shiny bit plus emotion index, default is zero and not sent
boss as an existing creature with a stat boost block, an emotion tint and held items
change: do not drop the signature skill at the top stage; add one new trait there instead
cap basic attack motions at about 8 instead of 30
no multi-creature legendary boards beyond the 3-attacker limit
our own names, art and family table; no species names or sprite looks
re-implement from the idea; do not copy GPL code
look_test: One 375-wide strip of our own assets: a family at stage 1, 2 and 3 with the same silhouette; the stage 2 form in two mood variants (shiny bit off and on) with identical stats; and an elite version of stage 3 with a slightly larger silhouette, one changed element hit look, one swapped attack effect and a boss tint. Dom judges whether the family reads at a glance and whether the elite reads as that family's boss. Preview only, no release rows.
